facts.value: Your ASURITE User ID is the official login name you’ll use to access most ASU systems and services.
To log in to My ASU, navigate to my.asu.edu, enter your ASURITE User ID and password, then click the 'Sign In' button.
ASU will send messages to the non-ASU personal email address provided on the admission application until the student enrolls in classes.
You will receive your official @asu.edu email address once you are enrolled in classes.
To review your transfer credits, visit the ASU Transfer Guide, log in with your ASURITE User ID and password, and click on My Transfer Guide.
Confirm your place in ASU’s incoming class by submitting your enrollment deposit via My ASU.
In the Transfer Student Orientation, you will prepare for your first semester by completing essential next steps for enrollment.
You must pay your enrollment deposit and meet with an academic advisor before you can register for classes.
Complete the 2026-2027 FAFSA for Spring 2027 and the 2027-2028 FAFSA for Fall 2027.
Transfer scholarships are available to help pay for tuition, housing, books, and other costs when you transfer to ASU.
You must submit your measles, mumps, and rubella immunization form before classes begin.
